text:
jordan_sales: Stellaris.ai wants a 5-day POC with their custom model 'stellaris-neo-14b' for RAG+chat. They asked about compatibility, rough cost, and any enterprise blockers. Can SE/infra/security triage?
mei_se: What artifact format and tokenizer? Also their target context length?
jordan_sales: They uploaded HF tar.gz (pt weights) + tokenizer.json. They say 48k context is supported but want to verify.
mei_se: 48k is within our max but check whether they expect full-attention vs sliding-window. Need to validate tokenizer type (bpe vs sentencepiece) and rotary/ALiBi. If tokenizer differs from our default we can generate an adapter but adds time.
omar_infra: Infra note: stellaris-neo-14b @ 4-bit + 48k KV will inflate per-request KV ~3GB. For concurrency >5 recommend Dedicated with 2x A100-80GB or 3-4x A40 with sharding. Hosted isolated single-node is possible for low concurrency tests but expect latency spike for full 48k sessions.
mei_se: SE plan: tokenizer sanity, build variants (4-bit, 8-bit, fp16), run their 300-query eval set, perf sweep at ctx slices (1k/8k/48k) and concurrencies (1/3/6). ETA ~4 business days after artifacts validated.
claire_security: Security: we need license & provenance check and SCA. If license restricts redistribution Hosted multi-tenant will be blocked; we can do Hosted isolated or Private. Also require DPA if PII expected. For Hosted we must ensure artifact stays in isolated tenant bucket with KMS; for Private, artifact can stay in customer VPC.
jordan_sales: Pricing ask: rough ballpark for Hosted isolated vs Dedicated 1-week POC, plus any one-time variant validation fee?
omar_infra: Ballpark: Hosted isolated sandbox ~= $4.5k/day (includes operator time + isolated runtime). Dedicated minimal for a week (2x A100 reserved) ~= $20k-$26k/week depending on egress/KMS. Variant validation fee ~= $1,250 one-time. Formal quote from finance required.
mei_se: High-risk summary for email: 1) tokenizer mismatch requiring adapter (adds ~1 day), 2) 48k KV overhead may force Dedicated at moderate concurrency, 3) license/provenance restrictions could block Hosted. Also external RAG DB egress if they plan to call customer vector DB.
claire_security: I'll start the security gate checklist and ping Legal about their license terms. If they insist on no copy on our hosts, they'll need Private deployment and network setup (~5 business days).
jordan_sales: Great. Ask them to stage eval set and share license + exact expected concurrency. Mei  please kick off builds when HF tar appears in staging.
mei_se: Will do  I'll watch the staging bucket and start a 4-bit variant build + initial QC once it's there.
poc-bot: Created ticket SE-5320 "Stellaris stellaris-neo-14b POC variant & perf" assigned to mei_se, due 2024-12-01. :rocket:
